title: Marketing & Sales
completion_message: ¡Excelente! El vocabulario de Marketing y Ventas te ayudará a promocionar y vender tus ideas al mundo.

parts.visual:
Marketing: 
- Target audience / Target market (Público objetivo). 
- Launch a campaign (Lanzar una campaña). 
- Brand awareness (Reconocimiento de marca). 
Ej: We need to launch a new campaign to increase our brand awareness among our target audience.
parts.audio: Marketing. Target audience or target market means the people you want to sell to. Launch a campaign. Brand awareness means how well people know your brand. For example: We need to launch a new campaign to increase our brand awareness.

parts.visual:
Ventas: 
- Boost sales (Aumentar las ventas). 
- Retail (Venta minorista / al por menor). 
- Wholesale (Venta mayorista / al por mayor). 
Ej: If we sell wholesale, we can boost our sales significantly.
parts.audio: Sales. Boost sales means to increase sales. Retail means selling to the public in small quantities. Wholesale means selling in large quantities, usually to stores. For example: If we sell wholesale, we can boost our sales significantly.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta de marketing o ventas.

questions.question: Teenagers are our main ____ audience. (Público objetivo).
We are going to ____ a new marketing campaign next month. (Lanzar).
The logo helps to build brand ____. (Reconocimiento / Conciencia de marca).
We need a strategy to ____ our sales before the end of the year. (Impulsar / Aumentar fuertemente).
They don't sell directly to the public. They only sell ____. (Al por mayor / Mayorista).
Supermarkets are part of the ____ industry. (Al por menor / Minorista).
questions.explanation: Retail = al por menor (venta directa al consumidor).

questions.question: What is our competitive ____? Why are we better than them? (Ventaja competitiva).
We must analyze our ____ to understand their weaknesses. (Competidores).
The iPhone has a very large market ____. (Cuota de mercado).
questions.explanation: Market share = cuota de mercado (porcentaje del mercado que dominas).

questions.question: We need to do some market ____ before launching the product. (Investigación).
Our ____ line includes phones, tablets, and laptops. (Línea de productos).
We offer a 20% ____ to new customers. (Descuento).
Apple is a very famous global ____. (Marca).
We spent $50,000 on ____ on social media. (Publicidad).
questions.explanation: Advertising = publicidad (el concepto general). An advertisement (o ad) es un anuncio específico.

questions.question: I saw a great ____ for that car on TV. (Anuncio).
questions.explanation: Advertisement (o ad / advert) = anuncio publicitario (la pieza concreta).

questions.question: They are running a special ____: buy one, get one free. (Promoción).
Our ____ profit this month was very high. (Ganancia/Beneficio).
The product is currently out of ____. We have no more. (Stock / Existencias).
questions.explanation: Out of stock = agotado, sin existencias. (Lo opuesto es 'in stock').

questions.question: We need a catchy ____ for the campaign, like 'Just Do It'. (Eslogan).
We have to meet our sales ____ this month. (Cuota / Objetivo).
questions.explanation: Sales target / quota = objetivo de ventas.
